TEAM-5261.output:
Merged PR #635 into base feature/TEAM-5259-music-video-journey-broken-canvas-upload (merge commit ef473bf). Base was already up to date with main (7c06a7b), so the sync created no merge commit.

ROOT CAUSE (confirmed in code; I could NOT read session logs because the hub creds have no CloudWatch access to the Juno account):
The turn started freeform with the MP3 attached in chat, and the agent mounted music_video partway through.
- RC1: the server creates text-music_video-<ts> only after set_journey streams through (server.py:2089). The agent turn had already bound campaign_id="" (agent.py:4296), so every mv tool returned "no campaign bound" (mv_tools.py:180).
- RC2: the agent fell back to the freeform tools show_idea/show_arc/show_song/set_subtitles. The music-video canvas has no section for their cards (index.html:4203), and the render functions return early, so the cards were silently dropped.
- RC3: audio/mpeg is accepted on upload. But only /mv/upload records the song on the campaign row (server.py:14831), so a chat-attached MP3 never became the campaign song.
- Client: the 'campaign' event handler never adopted the music-video campaign, and the journey mount then cleared mv.cid.
- Hypothesis (a) is confirmed in effect and (c) is refined. Hypothesis (b) is refuted: "text-" is the normal source prefix ({source}-{journey}-{ts}).

FIX:
- The server reserves the music-video campaign id and passes it to the agent. set_journey('music_video') adopts it, under guards: nothing bound yet, same turn token, brand bound, strict id pattern. The _resolve_campaign checks are unchanged.
- The server creates the row conditionally under that id, with a fresh-id fallback.
- New shared helper _mv_record_source_sync, used by both /mv/upload and the new chat-song attach. It writes the existing song fields and never overwrites a song already on the row.
- On music_video, show_idea/show_arc/show_song/set_subtitles now refuse and name the music-video tools to use instead: design_mv_intro/style_mv, style_mv/plan_mv_shotlist, analyze_mv_source/map_mv_beats, style_mv_captions.
- The client adopts the campaign after the mount, and a stray card now shows a status line instead of vanishing.
- No new persisted fields.

DEVIATION FROM done_when: the four foreign cards are not drawn on the music-video canvas. The agent is redirected to the music-video tools, so the canvas fills with its own song, style, captions and intro cards. Mapping the foreign cards onto music-video sections would display data the video render never uses.

REGRESSION TESTS (red on base, green on fix):
- test_mv_midturn_bind.py: 15 failed → 21 passed. It checks that the foreign tools refuse on music_video and that the named music-video tools produce mv canvas blocks.
- test_mv_midturn_mount.py: 7 failed → 10 passed. It checks a single campaign row, the attached MP3 recorded as the song, and no overwrite of an existing song.
- mv-campaign-adopt.unit.mjs: 6 of 9 failing → 9 of 9 passing.
All three are wired into .hub/ci.sh and canvas-ci.yml.

WHAT WAS ACTUALLY RUN: the full .hub/ci.sh locally reached "CI passed". The one change was installing Playwright without --with-deps, because the sandbox has no root. I re-ran the three new tests on the base HEAD after the merge: 40/40 pass.

NOT DONE: I did not run a live browser session against deployed Juno, so the symptom was not reproduced and then fixed live. Pipeline CI on the PR head was not checked by me.

SIBLING SWEEP: the song-row write is now one shared helper. Gaps found but not fixed (they predate this bug and are documented):
- the EHR metering holder is empty on a mount turn;
- /mv/upload always creates a new campaign when it isn't given one;
- _ensure_text_campaign can reuse a campaign from a different journey.

FOLLOW-UP: if the stream breaks and the turn resumes without re-running set_journey, the reservation is not re-adopted. The mv tools then refuse cleanly.

TEAM-5274.output:
Fixed R3-1: an eventual-consistency read could make `/mv/upload` return 404 for a campaign that was just mounted. PR #639 is merged into the integration branch (merge bf44bf0). The integration branch was already 0 behind main, so no sync was needed.

Root cause: the gate reads on `juno-campaigns` in apps/web-studio/server.py used an eventually consistent get_item. In `handle_mv_upload` (was :15034), that read missed a row created seconds earlier, so the handler raised "campaign not found" (HTTP 404) and did not store the audio.

Fix: one shared helper, `_get_campaign_consistent(cid)`, does the same get_item with ConsistentRead=True. It keeps the same key and the same `or {}` fallback, and passes errors through.

Sweep pattern: `get_item(TableName="juno-campaigns"` in server.py. It found 33 calls, server.py is the only file, and no alias variable exists.
- 25 calls now use the helper.
- Tier A, 18 gates: all 7 ticket-listed sites (6939, 13769, 14463, 14539 `_mv_row_sync`, 15034 upload, 15801 produce, 16567 status) plus `_sample_final_frames_sync`, `_campaign_resumable`, `_campaign_load`, `_perf_campaign_row`, voice delete, 2 media-visibility gates, `_assert_owner`, `_require_own_campaign`, 2 screenshot-push ownership checks and the attach precheck.
- Tier B, 7 post-write re-reads: `_code_camp_fresh`, the 6950 re-read, reel_qa, 3 mv_status re-reads and listing pull.
- Tier C, 5 left as eventual reads, each allow-listed in the AST guard with its reason: a projection read in `_voice_scene_prune`, `_voice_save` ×2 (a read-modify-write, filed as a follow-up), and 2 content-type checks after renders.
- Four test fakes got `**kw` on get_item. No other test changes.

Regression tests (tests/test_mv_midturn_mount.py):
- `test_mv_upload_stores_the_song_when_only_a_consistent_read_sees_the_row` runs the real `handle_mv_upload` against a fake that returns the row only when ConsistentRead=True.
- A parametrised gate sweep, an AST guard and a test of the helper's contract.

What I actually ran:
- New tests with server.py at 7ce04c6: 32 failed, 3 passed. The upload test failed with `404 {"error":"campaign not found"}`.
- New tests with the fix: 35 passed. The whole file: 65 passed, also on bf44bf0.
- The CI python groups that import server.py all passed: 904 passed with 8 skipped, then 13, 101, 190 and 29, plus test_mv_terminal at 19.
- I did not run the browser, Playwright or build parts of ci.sh, or the agents/MCP groups.
- No live AWS run.

No new persisted state.

TITLE: Music Video Journey Broken - Canvas/Upload/Progress Issues
SEVERITY: blocks_work
COMPONENT: other
STEPS TO REPRODUCE: 1. User initiated music video journey and uploaded an MP3 (BetterMan.mp3).
2. Attempted to set story arc, song details, caption style, and idea using respective tools.
3. Canvas did not update, remaining empty.
4. User expressed frustration and requested a bug report, highlighting the broken end-to-end experience.
EXPECTED: The music video journey should have progressed through its steps, with the canvas updating to reflect the story arc, song details, caption style, and intro card. Uploaded media should be clearly processed and visible.
ACTUAL: The music video journey did not progress as expected. The canvas remained empty despite multiple tool calls (show_arc, show_song, set_subtitles, show_idea). User reported an MP3 upload (BetterMan.mp3) that was dropped in chat but not fully processed or reflected on the canvas, leading to confusion about its status. The user explicitly stated 'the whole experience is broken'.
